items.title: Killerroboter: UN-Konferenz endet mit Minimalkompromiss
items.teaser: Killerroboter können Ziele auswählen und Angriffe auslösen - ohne menschliche Beteiligung. Die UN sollten dafür Schranken erarbeiten. Das Wann und Wie bleibt aber unter auch wegen Widerstand aus Russland und den USA ungeklärt.

items.title: War update: 203 combat engagements on front line over past day, most in Pokrovsk direction
items.teaser: A total of 203 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 20.

items.title: Russian attacks in Sumy region leaves three injured over past day
items.teaser: Three civilians were injured in Russian attacks in the Sumy region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,634,860 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,730 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 117 of 148 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 117 of the 148 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 20.

items.title: Two injured by falling Russian drone debris in Kyiv
items.teaser: Two houses caught fire in Kyiv following a Russian attack on 21 November, as the city faced simultaneous missile and drone threats after several overnight air-raid warnings.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 1.730 weitere Soldaten an einem Tag und zwei Luftabwehrsysteme
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 21. November 2026 auf rund 1.634.860Soldaten, darunter 1.730 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times since evening: Two killed, 55 injured
items.teaser: Since the evening of November 20, Russian forces have attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles. Two people were killed and 55 injured. Children were among both the victims and the injured.

items.title: Fast zehn Angriffe auf Region Dnipropetrowsk seit dem Abend – zwei Tote, 55 Verletzte
items.teaser: Die russischen Truppen hatten seit dem Abend des 20. November fünf Rayons der Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Drohnen und Raketen angegriffen.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, hits recorded at 19 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, including 87 jet-powered UAVs, against Ukraine overnight. Strikes were recorded at 19 locations, with the attack still ongoing as of the morning of 21 November.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attacks in Kharkiv region rises to 11, including two children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region has risen to 11, including two children.

items.title: Number of people injured in strikes on central Kryvyi Rih rises to 58, including six children
items.teaser: A 20-year-old paramedic and a seven-year-old boy were killed in Russian strikes on Kryvyi Rih. Eleven people remain in a serious condition, while dozens of buildings and emergency vehicles have been damaged.

items.title: Russian army loses another 1,730 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 21, 2026, are estimated at approximately 1,634,860 personnel, including 1,730 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: More than 50 settlements without electricity in Sarny district following Russian attack
items.teaser: More than 50 settlements in the Sarny district of the Rivne region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack. Ongoing air raid alerts are preventing repair crews from quickly addressing the damage.

items.title: Russia unlikely to increase traffic on Kerch Bridge even after repairs – Pletenchuk
items.teaser: Even if restoration work is carried out on the railway section of the Kerch Bridge, Russia is unlikely to risk increasing the load on it.

items.title: Kindergarten hit in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, man injured
items.teaser: A kindergarten was hit in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia. An elderly man was injured, and a fire broke out in a neighboring residential building.

items.title: Russians kill two and injure over 20, including child, in Zaporizhzhia Oblast over past day – photo
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out hundreds of attacks on settlements across Zaporizhzhia Oblast over the past 24 hours, damaging houses, cars and infrastructure facilities. A kindergarten was also targeted overnight.

items.title: Russia launches another attack on Kryvyi Rih, fire breaks out at industrial facility
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched another drone attack on Kryvyi Rih, sparking a fire at an industrial facility.

items.title: Russia loses 1,730 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,730 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: 'To us, he is enemy and murderer': Zelensky on Putin, whom Trump called friend
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he considers Russian dictator Vladimir Putin a murderer and an enemy of Ukraine, after US President Donald Trump referred to Putin as his friend.

items.title: Rain expected across Ukraine today, temperatures up to 14°C
items.teaser: Light rain is expected across Ukraine on Saturday, November 21, with wind gusts reaching up to 20 m/s.

items.title: Russia launches up to 200 attack drones nightly and more than 100 during the day – Ihnat
items.teaser: Russian forces are attacking Ukraine with strike drones virtually around the clock, launching more than 100 during the day and up to 200 at night. On some days, jet-powered UAVs account for as much as 95% of the total.

items.title: Russians attack Kryvyi Rih again, striking industrial facility
items.teaser: A jet-powered Russian drone struck an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih overnight, causing a fire. The attack followed a ballistic missile strike that killed two people and injured 47 others.

items.title: Tote und Verletzte bei Raketenangriff auf Krywyj Rih
items.teaser: Krywyj Rih ist die Heimatstadt des ukrainischen Präsidenten Selenskyj. Nun wurde die Industriestadt erneut mit ballistischen Raketen beschossen. Eine Rakete schlug demnach nahe Wohnhäusern und einem Restaurant ein.

items.title: Elon Musk hires lobbyists as Democrats plan investigation into Starshield restrictions in Ukraine – Fox News
items.teaser: Elon Musk's company has recruited five Washington lobbyists as Democrats prepare congressional investigations into Starlink and Starshield restrictions, Pentagon contracts and potential conflicts of interest.

items.title: Russia lacks technical capacity to repair Crimean Bridge – Pletenchuk
items.teaser: Russia currently lacks the technical capacity needed to repair the Kerch Strait Bridge. The alternatives for travel to temporarily occupied Crimea remain a land route through the occupied territories of the Azov region and ferry crossings.

items.title: Civil society is Ukraine’s superpower. A free course traces how it grew from Euromaidan to the front
items.teaser: It was born in November 2013 out of helplessness, kept the army supplied when the state could not, and the West may soon need what it learned

items.title: Bringing equipment repairs closer to front line: NATO and Ukraine developing enhanced repair centers
items.teaser: NATO and Ukraine are developing a concept for enhanced repair centers that would bring industrial and logistical capabilities closer to the front line, enabling faster repairs and the quicker return of equipment to the battlefield.

items.title: Russia must feel what war is like: Crimean Bridge will not stand as it is legitimate target for Ukraine – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy defended strikes on the bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, saying Moscow uses it to transport weapons and that Kyiv will continue responding to Russian aggression.

items.title: Zelensky says Putin must understand Crimean Bridge 'will not stay,' warns Russia increasing double-tap strikes
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is increasing its double-tap strikes and even conducting triple-tap strikes to "kill as many people as possible" in its attacks.

items.title: Ukraine needs more jet fighters. But from where?
items.teaser: The Ukrainian air force's sole unit operating Western fighter types needs more jets. But there aren't a lot of obvious sources.

items.title: 54% of damaged healthcare infrastructure facilities restored in Chernihiv region
items.teaser: A total of 100 healthcare and social welfare facilities in Ukraine's Chernihiv region have been damaged by enemy shelling. So far, 54% of those facilities have been restored, while another 10% are being rebuilt.

items.title: Incoming Democratic chairman warns US lawmakers could halt SpaceX funding following Starshield slowdown in Ukraine, CNN reports
items.teaser: "Simply, our committee cannot authorize funds for the development of government systems that the government will not fully control," Democratic Rep. James Himes wrote.

items.title: Russia launches ballistic missile attack on central Kryvyi Rih: child and paramedic killed, at least 21 injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the centre of Kryvyi Rih with ballistic missiles on the evening of 20 November, injuring at least 21 people. A seven-year-old boy and a female paramedic have been killed in the attack.

items.title: Ukraine blocks Russian climate report containing data from occupied territories at COP31
items.teaser: At the UN Climate Change Conference COP31 in Antalya, the Ukrainian delegation blocked consideration of an agenda item concerning Russia's inclusion of data from temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories in its climate reporting.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-graft agencies say they face smear campaign as probes reach 'core of corruption system'
items.teaser: According to NABU Director Semen Kryvonos, the campaign aims to "shift the focus from the investigations to politics, conspiracy theories, and lies."

items.title: Russian colonel suspected of ordering use of chemical weapons against Ukrainian troops
items.teaser: Law enforcement authorities have declared a Russian colonel a suspect over orders to use chemical weapons against Ukrainian military personnel.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Around 50 settlements in Rivne Oblast left without power following Russian attack
items.teaser: A Russian strike on the Sarny district in Ukraine's west disrupted the electricity supply to dozens of settlements, while repeated air-raid warning are hampering repair work.

items.title: Two killed, including child, in Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih, injury toll rises to 42
items.teaser: The number of people injured in the strike on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 42, including four children. Two people have been killed.

items.title: War update: 157 clashes on front line, Pokrovsk sector remains hottest
items.teaser: A total of 157 combat engagements took place on the front line. Russian forces launched 16 attacks on Ukrainian positions in the Pokrovsk sector, losing more than 30 troops.

items.title: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kryvyi Rih kill 7-year-old, paramedic, injure 42 others in double-tap attack
items.teaser: "The occupying forces launched a missile strike on the territory of a restaurant in the city center, at a time when families with children, staff, and an emergency medical team that had responded to a call were inside," Interior Minister Ivan Vykhivskyi wrote.

items.title: Mutmaßlicher Anschlagsplan: Dänen weisen russischen Diplomaten aus
items.teaser: Russland soll auf dänischem Boden einen Anschlag auf einen ukrainisch-amerikanischen Rapper geplant haben. Als Reaktion wurde ein russischer Diplomat ausgewiesen. Zwei Verdächtige sitzen in Untersuchungshaft.

items.title: Nine people injured in Russian strikes in Kharkiv region on Friday
items.teaser: Nine people were injured in Russian strikes in Kharkiv and the surrounding region on Friday, November 20.

items.title: Ukraine to build future security architecture with European support – NSATU Commander
items.teaser: Ukraine will lead the process of developing and maintaining its future security architecture, with support from European partners.

items.title: Russian forces attack Kryvyi Rih, injuring 20 people
items.teaser: Russian forces struck Kryvyi Rih, damaging a restaurant, garages and cars. Twenty people were injured.

items.title: Trump won't specify US security guarantees for Ukraine: We need to make a deal first
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump declined to outline Washington's potential security guarantees for Kyiv, saying an agreement must come first, despite earlier discussions of NATO-style protection for Ukraine.

items.title: White House wants Ukraine-Russia peace deal by January, FT reports
items.teaser: The U.S. President Donald Trump administration has told European and Ukrainian officials that it wants a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia to be reached by early January 2027, before Democrats take control of the U.S. Congress.

items.title: Russia attacks civilian business in Rivne Oblast, injuring one person
items.teaser: Russian forces targeted a civilian business in Ukraine's west on the evening of 20 November. Local authorities say one person was injured, according to early reports.

items.title: Europe sets up working groups to develop unified position ahead of next round of peace talks – source
items.teaser: European countries will coordinate their positions on peace negotiations concerning Ukraine within the Coalition of the Willing, NATO and the European Council. Meanwhile, specially established working groups involving the United States, Ukraine and European partners will work on documents intended to form the basis for

items.title: Diplomat ausgewiesen: Russland soll Mordkomplott gegen Rapper geplant haben - Dänemark reagiert
items.teaser: Zwei Dänen sollen einen Anschlag auf einen amerikanisch-ukrainischen Rapper geplant haben. Die dänischen Behörden vermuten den russischen Geheimdienst dahinter und bestellen Russlands Botschafter ein. Auch das Auswärtige Amt äußert sich.

items.title: Piloten der Einheit „Achilles“ haben in Richtung Wowtschansk russischen schwimmenden Transporter getroffen
items.teaser: Piloten der 429. selbständigen Drohneneinheit „Achilles“ haben in Richtung Wowtschansk einen schwimmenden Transporter angegriffen, den die russischen Invasoren zum Transport von Personal und Ausrüstung nutzen.

items.title: Russia launches massive attack on DTEK TPP, forcing it to halt generation
items.teaser: Russia has launched a massive attack on a DTEK thermal power plant, forcing it to suspend electricity generation.

items.title: Trump says Putin is "having a hard time because he's in a war that should have lasted one day"
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump says Vladimir Putin is having a hard time fighting a war in Ukraine that was supposed to last one day but has gone on for five years.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russia strikes 3 Kyiv bridges in massive aerial assault on Ukraine, at least 9 dead
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 20: 3 Kyiv bridges struck in massive Russian aerial assault on Ukraine, at least 9 dead 2 Russian Kh-101 missiles, drone, fall in Poland during Russian attack on Ukraine Ukraine deploys experimental laser air defense system in Kyiv At least 1,144 children killed or injured

items.title: Denmark expels Russian diplomat over alleged assassination plot on Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner
items.teaser: The expulsion follows the disclosure of an alleged plot by Russian intelligence services to assassinate Ukrainian rapper Albert Vasiliev, known professionally as Kyivstoner, ahead of a scheduled concert in Denmark on Sept. 25.

items.title: NABU and SAPO facing media attack, Kryvonos says
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office (SAPO) are facing a “media attack” aimed at shifting the focus from corruption investigations to conspiracy theories.

items.title: EU sports chief lambasts FIFA, International Olympic Committee, as 'main architects that support the Kremlin'
items.teaser: Regarding the new restrictions, four EU and national officials have told the Kyiv Independent that the European Commission is expected to unveil its 22nd sanctions package on Nov. 23, with measures related to sport expected to feature prominently.

items.title: Russians attack outskirts of Kharkiv, injuring two people
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a drone attack on the outskirts of Kharkiv on the evening of 20 November.

items.title: Did the Court Change its Approach to Defining or Proving Genocidal Intent in Gambia v. Myanmar and Did it Get it Right? Part I
items.teaser: As I explained in my quick-reaction post, the principal disagreement among the judges of the ICJ in Gambia v. items.title: Zelensky's party lawmaker sentenced to over 3 years in jail in bribery case
items.teaser: Serhiy Kuzminykh is the fourth lawmaker from President Volodymyr Zelensky's Servant of the People parliamentary faction to receive a prison sentence.

items.title: Russian attacks cause UAH 6 bln in damage to Kharkiv aircraft plant, Director says
items.teaser: Damage to the Kharkiv State Aircraft Manufacturing Company (KSAMC) caused by Russian shelling has reached UAH 6 billion.

items.title: Mehr als drei Dutzend UN-Mitgliedstaaten verurteilen Angriffe auf Ukraine und Verletzung polnischen Luftraums
items.teaser: Mehr als drei Dutzend UN-Mitgliedstaaten, vorwiegend aus der Europäischen Union, haben die russischen Angriffe auf Kyjiw und andere ukrainische Städte am 19. und 20. November, die zivile Opfer und Schäden an der Energieinfrastruktur zur Folge hatten, scharf verurteilt.

items.title: Warum Ukrainer den Howerla besteigen
items.teaser: Jährlich besteigen zahlreiche Ukrainer den Howerla, den höchsten Berg des Landes. Auch jetzt im Krieg ist er für viele ein Ort der Selbstvergewisserung und der Kraft.

items.title: Trump says Putin wants to end Russia's war against Ukraine through diplomacy
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump says Vladimir Putin wants to end Russia's war against Ukraine through diplomacy, but claims the hatred between Putin and Zelenskyy is complicating peace efforts.

items.title: Estonia summons Russian chargé d’affaires over attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: On November 20, Estonia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Russia’s chargé d’affaires to protest Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy responds to Trump calling Putin his friend: "For us, he is an enemy and a killer"
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has responded to his US counterpart Donald Trump calling Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin his "friend".

items.title: Sachsen-Anhalt - AfD kontrolliert jetzt den Verfassungsschutz
items.teaser: Eine als rechtsextrem eingestufte Partei stellt die Hälfte des Kontrollgremiums.

items.title: Moldova reports second drone incursion into its airspace in one day
items.teaser: An unauthorized drone flight into Moldova’s airspace was recorded twice on November 20.

items.title: Why a Donbas-for-NATO deal won’t work
items.teaser: Could Ukraine give up Donbas in exchange for NATO membership? President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the U.S. negotiators had floated the idea during the recent peace talks in Abu Dhabi, raising questions about the credibility of NATO’s security guarantees and the prospects for ending Russia’s war under such conditions

items.title: Russen attackierten Region Dnipropetrowsk am Freitag fast 20 Mal, es gibt Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Besatzer attackierten im Laufe des Tages vier Bezirke der Region Dnipropetrowsk fast 20 Mal. Dabei wurde eine Person getötet und eine weitere verletzt.

items.title: One killed and another injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched almost 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing one person and injuring another.

items.title: France calls for renewed debate on Ukraine's NATO membership – source
items.teaser: France is once again raising the issue of Ukraine's NATO membership amid an acceleration of negotiations to end the war and the need to define long-term security guarantees for Ukraine and Europe.

items.title: Trump administration wants Ukraine and Russia to reach peace deal by January 2027
items.teaser: The Trump administration has told European and Ukrainian officials that it wants Ukraine and Russia to reach a peace agreement by the beginning of January 2027.

items.title: Crimean Bridge attack: Dutch journalist says Russia-24 distorted his words
items.teaser: Russia's state propaganda channel Russia-24 used footage from a broadcast by Dutch radio station BNR, distorting the words of its correspondent, Geert Jan Hahn, in a report about the Crimean Bridge.

items.title: Germany backs new drone factory plan by SkyFall and Auterion
items.teaser: The venture would expand Ukrainian weapons production abroad, adding capacity away from Russia’s attacks on Ukraine while giving Germany a potential domestic supplier of systems developed through front-line experience, Auterion announced on Nov. 20.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Russian attack 'one of largest,' Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said Russia launched one of the largest aerial attacks since the invasion began. Poland accused Moscow of a "provocation," saying two missiles landed in the NATO country. Follow DW.

items.title: Trump claims Putin sent drones and ‘little missiles’ into Poland by mistake
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has claimed that Russian drones and missiles enter Polish territory "by mistake."

items.title: Ukrainian PM was in Poland when Russian missiles violated Polish airspace
items.teaser: A Polish media outlet has learned that Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi was at Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport when Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated Polish airspace.

items.title: At least 1,144 children killed or injured in Ukraine during Russia's war this year, UNICEF says
items.teaser: In October alone, child casualties rose by 150% compared with the same month last year, reaching at least 146, UNICEF said.

items.title: Company with foreign investment in Brovary near Kyiv hit by Russian strike
items.teaser: VBH Ukraine, a company with foreign investment that supplies window and door fittings, has been hit by a Russian strike on the town of Brovary, near Kyiv.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia rises to ten
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district has risen to ten.

items.title: EU genehmigt noch eine Milliarde Euro Militärhilfe für Ukraine
items.teaser: Der Rat der Europäischen Union hat zwei Beschlüsse gefasst, die die Bereitstellung neuer Militärhilfe in Höhe von 1 Milliarde Euro für die ukrainischen Streitkräfte im Rahmen des Europäischen Friedensfonds (EPF) durch gemeinsame Beschaffung von tödlicher und nichttödlicher Ausrüstung ermöglichen.

items.title: Merz: Unterstützung der Ukraine bringt uns Dividende
items.teaser: Seit dem Angriff Russlands unterstützt Deutschland die Ukraine - insgesamt mit mehr als 100 Milliarden Euro. Ausgaben, die sich auszahlen könnten. Kanzler Merz sieht - trotz des Krieges - positive Effekte für die deutsche Wirtschaft.

items.title: Polen wirft Russland gezielte Provokation vor
items.teaser: Mehrere Flugkörper sind in den polnischen Luftraum eingedrungen - nach Einschätzung der Regierung eine gezielte Provokation Russlands. Sie könnte in Zusammenhang mit einer Übung der Ukraine-Unterstützer stehen, die derzeit in Polen stattfindet.

items.title: Poland asks NATO allies to help strengthen its air defences
items.teaser: Poland's defence minister has called on NATO allies to provide additional F-35 fighter jets, AWACS aircraft and other resources after Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

items.title: Three occupation "officials" from Donetsk served with notices of suspicion for deporting 55 Ukrainian children
items.teaser: A former "official" of the so-called "Donetsk People's Republic" and her two accomplices have been served with notices of suspicion in absentia by Ukrainian law enforcement officers. items.title: EU approves another EUR 1B in military aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Council of the European Union has adopted two decisions allowing the provision of EUR 1 billion in additional military assistance to the Ukrainian Armed Forces through joint procurement of lethal and non-lethal equipment under the European Peace Facility (EPF).

items.title: EU allocates €1bn from European Peace Facility for military equipment for Ukraine
items.teaser: The EU has approved €1 billion from the European Peace Facility to supply Ukraine with drones, air defence equipment, ammunition and other military equipment by the end of 2027.

items.title: EU greenlights 1 billion euros in military support for Ukraine as top diplomat says Russia rejects peace
items.teaser: "If Moscow wants peace, its actions tell a different story... Ukraine can count on Europe to strengthen its hand on the battlefield and at the negotiating table," the EU's top diplomat Kaja Kallas said.

items.title: At least 1,144 children killed or injured in Ukraine in first ten months of 2026 – UNICEF
items.teaser: The number of children killed or injured in Ukraine as a result of the war in 2026 has already exceeded last year's figure and could approach the 2022 level by the end of the year.

items.title: 'Responsibility lies with Russian aggressor' — Austria pushes back against Moscow's claims over damage to embassy in Kyiv
items.teaser: The Russian Embassy alleged Moscow had repeatedly warned foreign nationals, including diplomatic staff, about the dangers of remaining in or traveling to Ukraine, adding that "full responsibility for any potential negative consequences lies entirely with the Austrian side."

items.title: Angriff auf Saporischschja: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf zehn
items.teaser: Nach feindlichem Beschuss im Rayon Kosmitschnyj in Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten auf zehn gestiegen.

items.title: Russian guided bomb strikes near apartment building in Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with guided aerial bombs. One of the bombs landed near an apartment building, injuring four people.

items.title: French official denies that Trump demanded halt in military support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Following Donald Trump's 19 November phone call with European leaders after the Shenzhen summit, a French presidential source has denied that Trump asked the allies to restrict or end military support for Ukraine.

items.title: Raketeneinschlag: NATO-Generalsekretär sagt Polen Unterstützung zu
items.teaser: Die Ukraine wurde in der Nacht erneut heftig von Russland attackiert. Dabei wurde auch Polen getroffen, wie die Regierung in Warschau mitteilte. Die NATO steht ihrem Mitglied zur Seite.

items.title: Estonia to close road borders with Russia in response to 'sustained aggression' against Europe
items.teaser: The range of methods used by Russia to threaten European security is leading some in Europe to say "hybrid" is no longer an appropriate term for Moscow's increasingly aggressive stance.

items.title: Russia strikes emergency hospital in Kharkiv, damaging MRI scan room – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked an emergency hospital in Kharkiv. A Russian drone has struck a room housing an MRI scanner. The scanner appears to have remained intact, but specialists will assess whether it is still functioning properly.

items.title: EU and UK pledge continued joint support for Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Union and the United Kingdom have pledged to continue supporting Ukraine in its fight against Russian aggression and to maintain pressure on Russia to achieve a just and lasting peace.

items.title: Ukraine’s drone war grew through October. Units log more than 2 million verified hits this year, with the peak month so far almost 2.5 times January
items.teaser: The drones also reach further behind the front: in September, hits more than 20 km back passed 11,000 for the first time, the Defense Ministry says.

items.title: Orlen expands Ukraine gas business with new Naftogaz deal
items.teaser: The deliveries will help Ukraine meet higher gas demand during winter and diversify its supplies as Russian attacks continue to threaten the country's energy infrastructure.

items.title: France welcomes Putin's invitation to Moscow: "We have never cut ties with Russia"
items.teaser: The Élysée Palace has welcomed Putin's invitation to formalise dialogue in Moscow, while insisting Europeans must participate fully in upcoming talks with the US and Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike 3 Russian ballistic missile launchers, air defense gun-missile system, Kyiv says
items.teaser: One launcher was destroyed, while the damage to the other two is still being assessed, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte treffen russisches Luftverteidigungssystem in Region Brjansk und Drohnensteuerpunkt in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 19. und in der Nacht zum 20. November griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte mehrere russische Militärobjekte auf russischem Territorium sowie in den Regionen Donezk, Luhansk und Saporischschja an.

items.title: Ukraine seeks to deepen rail modernization cooperation with Deutsche Bahn – Koretskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine is seeking to deepen its strategic partnership with Germany's Deutsche Bahn, particularly in the development of standard-gauge rail lines, infrastructure modernization, and upgrades to locomotives, rolling stock and railway stations.

items.title: Merz identifies obstacles to deeper defense cooperation with Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has called for better conditions for joint defense production with Ukraine, identifying export duties and legal restrictions on transferring intellectual property rights as obstacles to the development of joint technologies.

items.title: 'It was simply my turn' — Buryat activist brushes off prison sentence for research on Russian losses
items.teaser: A U.S.-based researcher and Buryat activist sentenced to prison in absentia by Russia for her work on Moscow's military recruitment and losses has brushed off the case against her, saying it was "simply my turn." Maria Vyushkova, 45, received the six-year sentence on Nov.

items.title: Deutsch-ukrainisches Wirtschaftsforum
items.teaser: Deutsch-ukrainisches Wirtschaftsforum in Berlin u.a. mit einer Rede von Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz (CDU)

items.title: Milfey confectionery workshop destroyed in Russian attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: Confectionery manufacturer Milfey has said its Kyiv production site suffered heavy damage after overnight Russian attacks on 19-20 November and posted a video showing the devastating effects of the fire.

items.title: Merz names two conditions for continued financial support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Continued reforms in the areas of the rule of law and the fight against corruption are prerequisites for further financial assistance to Ukraine, attracting investment and maintaining long-term support from Germany.

items.title: Russian missile hits house in Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast but fails to explode – photos
items.teaser: On the morning of 20 November, during a large-scale Russian attack on Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast, a missile struck a house in the Burshtyn hromada. Two people were rescued from the house. A hromada is an administrative unit designating a village, several villages, or a town, and their adjacent territories.

items.title: Kombinierter Raketen- und Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: Zahl der Toten auf sieben, der Verletzten auf 17 gestiegen

items.teaser: Since the beginning of 2026, units of Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck more than two million enemy targets using drones, killing or severely injuring more than 320,000 Russian invaders. The highest number of strikes was recorded in October, at more than 257,000.

items.title: Russian forces deploy fiber-optic-controlled Molniya drones on various front-line sectors – presidential advisor
items.teaser: Russian forces have been using Molniya drones controlled via fiber-optic cables on various sectors of the front line over the past several days.

items.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
items.teaser: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Swiss REPIC offers grants for renewable energy projects in Ukraine
items.teaser: Innovative projects in renewable energy, energy efficiency and resource efficiency in Ukraine can apply for grants of up to CHF 750,000 under a funding program offered by the Swiss platform REPIC.

items.title: Russia launches mass missile attack against Ukraine after Putin vows retaliation
items.teaser: Explosions rocked Kyiv at around 1:25 a.m. on Nov. 20, according to Kyiv Independent journalists on the ground. Earlier, monitoring channels reported that Russia had launched Tu-160 strategic bombers.

items.title: Ukraine performs first bone-anchored implant surgeries for limb prosthetics in two veterans
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Swedish doctors have performed the first two operations in Ukraine under a pilot project providing free osseointegration prosthetics to veterans.

items.title: Simferopol residents rush to stock up on food and fuel after attacks on Kerch Bridge – Chubarov
items.teaser: Residents of Simferopol in temporarily occupied Crimea are buying up food and fuel in large quantities following attacks on the Kerch Bridge.

items.title: Zelensky tells world superpowers how they can end Russia's war against Ukraine
items.teaser: "If you want to stop war, stop trade with Russia," Zelensky told reporters following a Coalition of the Meeting summit in Berlin on Nov. 19.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1730: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit Kerch Bridge railway link for the third time in a week, halting trains to occupied Crimea
items.teaser: A Ukrainian officer said drones passed video to missiles to hit exact points on the bridge without Starlink, China tightened export controls on some drone parts used by Russia while exempting key components, and France will give Ukraine two Mirage 2000-5Fs and AASM Hammer 250 bombs by end of 2026.

items.title: Ukraine: EU belegt 113 Personen und Organisationen mit Sanktionen, um Russlands Fähigkeit zur Finanzierung seines Angriffskriegs weiter einzuschränken
items.teaser: Der Rat hat restriktive Maßnahmen gegen 12 Personen und 101 Organisationen, die im Banken-, Finanz- und Energiesektor tätig sind, aufgrund ihrer Rolle bei der Finanzierung der Kriegsanstrengungen Russlands und der Unterstützung seiner Schattenflotte verhängt.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Save The Date
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

Ukrainian Defense Forces strike Russian drone operators in occupied Kherson region
items.teaser: The locations of Russian drone crews were identified in the temporarily occupied part of the Kherson region, and the Ukrainian Defense Forces carried out precision strikes against them.

items.title: 2 Holländer in Frankfurt verhaftet - Im Fußraum ihres Pkw lag Sprengstoff
items.teaser: Polizei verhindert mutmaßlich geplanten Anschlag in Frankfurt.

items.title: Zelensky meets with Witkoff, Kushner and European national security advisers
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelensky met with U.S. presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as well as European national security advisers.

items.title: "Koalition der Willigen" berät in Berlin über Unterstützung der Ukraine
items.teaser: "Koalition der Willigen" berät in Berlin über Unterstützung der Ukraine

items.title: Zelensky meets with Merz to discuss financial support, stronger air defense
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky continued his talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in a bilateral meeting.

items.title: Coalition of the Willing calls on Russia to accept winter energy truce
items.teaser: In a joint statement, the leaders of Germany, France, the U.K., and Ukraine called on Russia to accept both a winter energy ceasefire and a truce allowing safe passage for food exports in the Black Sea.

items.title: Landtag - AfD erhält zwei Sitze im Parlamentarischen Kontrollgremium in Sachsen-Anhalt
items.teaser: Der Landtag von Sachsen-Anhalt hat zwei AfD-Politiker in das Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium gewählt, das den Verfassungsschutz kontrolliert.

items.title: China tightens export controls on drone parts used by Russia, but key components remain exempt
items.teaser: New Chinese export controls target engines, radio modules, and powerful electric motors used in Russian drones. Ukraine says the measures are a start but leave several critical components outside the restrictions.

items.title: 'Humanitarian mission' for Kostiantynivka: Is it a trap?
items.teaser: Russian President Putin has proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, like the recent operation in Oleshky. Experts warn this could serve military, not humanitarian, aims. What should Kyiv do?

items.title: Putin proposes second humanitarian ceasefire — is it a trap?
items.teaser: Russian President Putin has suggested evacuating civilians from the embattled Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka. But experts warn this could serve military, not humanitarian, aims. What should Kyiv do?

items.title: European Commission pledges to fast-track review of Ukraine’s emissions trading bill – Environment Ministry
items.teaser: The European Commission has pledged to speed up its review of Ukraine’s draft law establishing a national greenhouse gas emissions trading system. Ukraine is awaiting an opinion on whether the legislation complies with EU directives.

items.title: Zelensky sees “huge chance” for peace if Washington turns up pressure on Putin
items.teaser: How quickly Russia’s war against Ukraine can be brought to an end will depend largely on the United States’ willingness to put pressure on the Kremlin.

items.title: Kushner confirms: U.S. considering NATO Article 5-like security guarantees for Ukraine
items.teaser: The United States is prepared to consider providing Ukraine with security guarantees modeled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty, but they must serve U.S. interests and form part of a broader package of security measures.

items.title: China tightens export controls on components for Russian drones
items.teaser: Exporters must now seek licenses to export certain drone components, including the engines used to produce Russia's jet-powered Geran attack drones.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russian drones kill 1, damage 2 European embassies, cathedral in hours-long drone raid on Kyiv
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 19: 'For Russia, nothing is sacred' — Massive Russian drone attack on Kyiv kills 1, damages St. Volodymyr's Cathedral, embassies 'We will not negotiate' — Putin addresses Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge 'Please vacate Crimea' —

items.title: Kushner reports progress on security guarantees for Ukraine and postwar reconstruction
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner has said that talks with Ukraine and European partners have made progress on future security guarantees, Ukraine’s accession to the EU, and a postwar reconstruction plan.

items.title: tagesschau 20:00 Uhr

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland hat 2026 auf dem Schlachtfeld verloren, versucht aber, seinen Frust an Zivilbevölkerung auszulassen
items.teaser: Russland habe 2026 auf dem Schlachtfeld gegen die Ukraine verloren, versuche aber dafür seinen Frust durch Luftterror an Zivilisten auszulassen. Der Kreml missachte dabei alle Kriegsregeln.

items.title: Ukraine-Russland-Verhandlungen: Wer spricht für Europa und wer nicht?
items.teaser: Ein europäisches Verhandlungsteam soll bei künftigen Ukraine-Russland-Gesprächen mit am Tisch sitzen. Doch wie haltbar ist diese Übereinkunft von vergangener Woche und was sagt sie über den Zustand Europas?

items.title: Merz will baldige Gespräche mit Russland auf neutralem Boden
items.teaser: Die "Koalition der Willigen" verspricht, der Ukraine "so lange wie nötig" zu helfen. Nach dem Gipfel in Berlin rief Kanzler Merz Russlands Präsident Putin auf, die Waffen niederzulegen. Einen Frieden könne es nur mit Beteiligung Europas geben.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia loses 2026 to Ukraine on battlefield but trying to take it out on civilians
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Russia lost 2026 to Ukraine on the battlefield but, disregarding all rules of warfare, is trying to make up for it by targeting civilians with aerial terror.

items.title: How to play GTA 6 in a warzone
items.teaser: The biggest game of the decade is out after a wait of more than 13 years. "The game is loading, the vacation has been agreed upon, all that's left to do is survive," one Ukrainian gamer posted on Reddit days before its release on Nov. 19,

items.title: Austrian chancellor "shocked" as Russian strike damages Kyiv embassy
items.teaser: Austria's leader underlined the immunity of diplomatic facilities and expressed relief that all mission personnel in the Ukrainian capital escaped physical harm.

items.title: Aggressor cannot dictate unrealistic security demands – Burnham
items.teaser: Europe is clear about what it will and will not accept in negotiations on peace in Ukraine, while also standing firmly on Ukraine’s side.

items.title: Koalition der Willigen in Berlin: "Wir halten zur Ukraine"
items.teaser: Die sogenannte Koalition der Willigen stärkt der Ukraine in Berlin den Rücken. Und alle blicken zum Treffen der USA, Russlands und China in Shenzhen. Von dort aus lädt Präsident Putin die Europäer nach Moskau ein.

items.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
items.teaser: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Russians kill man in drone attack on Kushuhum, Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: Acting regional head reported a deadly aerial attack in the Zaporizhzhia district on 19 November.

items.title: Macron calls for four-way peace talks, reopens debate on Ukraine’s NATO membership
items.teaser: French President Emmanuel Macron has said that peace negotiations should involve Ukraine, Russia, the United States, and Europe. He also called for revisiting the question of Ukraine’s NATO membership as part of long-term European security.

items.title: Jeder dritte Rubel für Kriegswirtschaft: russisches Parlament verabschiedet Rekord-Kriegsbudget 2027
items.teaser: Russland plant für das Jahr 2027 Rekordsummen für die Kriegswirtschaft. Militärausgaben werden auf 17,1 Billionen Rubel, umgerechnet rund 178 Milliarden Euro erhöht, wie The Moscow Times berichtet.

items.title: Merz' Mega-Gegengipfel: Das Bild ist die Botschaft
items.teaser: An der Seite von Selenskyj hat Kanzler Merz Vertreter aus 37 Ländern empfangen - und drei Botschaften an Trump, Putin und Xi geschickt. Trump wiederum redet mit - per Handy.

items.title: Macron: Europe never broke off contact with Moscow
items.teaser: Emmanuel Macron confirmed US envoys briefed Berlin summit leaders on talks with Putin and Xi while stressing the need to finalise security guarantees for Kyiv.

items.title: 'No viable suggestions' on Russian assets yet, Belgium's Euroclear tells European Parliament
items.teaser: Supporting Ukraine is essential, but so is maintaining financial stability, says Euroclear, the world's largest single holder of immobilized Russian assets.

items.title: Latvian diplomats to continue working in Ukraine despite Russian strikes – FM
items.teaser: Latvian Foreign Minister Girts Jaunzems has said that Latvian diplomats will carry on their work in Ukraine despite Russian strikes on diplomatic missions in Ukrainian cities.

items.title: Politico: Trump casts doubt on further military aid spending for Ukraine
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump questioned the merits of additional expenditure on military assistance for Ukraine during a phone call held amid the Coalition of the Willing meeting on 19 November.

items.title: Trump envoy: US convinces Russia of need for Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine
items.teaser: Speaking in Berlin after Coalition of the Willing talks, Jared Kushner noted that Donald Trump may consider backing a wider security arrangement if it aligns with Washington's interests.

items.title: Merz outlines key conditions for peace deal with Russia, floats partial sanctions relief
items.teaser: Any future peace agreement on Ukraine must be based on preserving its sovereignty, using the line of contact as the starting point for territorial negotiations, allowing it to pursue European integration, and providing strong security guarantees.

items.title: Ukraine deploys experimental laser air defense system in Kyiv
items.teaser: In early November Carmine Sky deployed its new "Blysk" laser system as part of Kyiv's air defenses. The company says the system can burn through the hull of a Shahed type drone in a matter of seconds.

items.title: Interview: Move fast to secure Kyiv's future, Brussels economy chief tells Ukraine, EU countries
items.teaser: BRUSSELS, Belgium — EU countries and Ukraine need to respond quickly and decisively to a new financing proposal for Kyiv, the EU's Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis told the Kyiv Independent in an interview on Nov. 18. items.title: Agrarminister: kein Risiko für Ernährungssicherheit in Ukraine
items.teaser: Für die Ernährungssicherheit in der Ukraine besteht nach Einschätzung des Ministeriums für Agrarpolitik derzeit kein Risiko.

items.title: Ukrainian forces refute Russian claim of capturing Shylivka in Donetsk region
items.teaser: The claim that Shylivka was allegedly captured by the Russian Typhoon assault unit is false.

items.title: 'We will not negotiate' — Putin addresses Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge
items.teaser: The remarks marked the Russian president's first public reaction to the attacks on the bridge, which he described as having sustained "serious damage."

items.title: Zelenskyy: Europeans to take part in negotiation formats with Russians
items.teaser: After talks with Western partners, Kyiv and Paris confirmed that five nations, the EU and NATO will represent the continent at the table alongside Washington.

items.title: Russia destroys 420 UOC churches, kills 25 priests since start of full-scale invasion
items.teaser: During the invasion, Russian troops have destroyed 420 churches belonging to the Ukrainian Orthodox Church (UOC), killed 25 of its priests, and sentenced clergy members who refused to submit to Patriarch Kirill.

items.title: Kathedrale und zwei Botschaften in Kyjiw bei russischem Angriff beschädigt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw am 19. November sind die Fenster der Wladimirkathedrale beschädigt worden.

items.title: Facing charges, SBU general goes all-in against anti-graft agencies investigating him
items.teaser: Days after his release from pre-trial detention, SBU Major General Serhiy Duka went on the offensive against the anti-corruption agencies responsible for his arrest. items.title: EU ambassador to Ukraine recounts downing of Russian drone overhead
items.teaser: The bloc's envoy and a colleague were rushed inside a hotel by security after an aerial target was destroyed nearby during a day of attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Austrian Embassy in Kyiv damaged in Russian attack
items.teaser: The Embassy of Austria in Ukraine was damaged during a Russian drone attack on Kyiv.

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfen: Ergebnisse des Treffens der "Koalition der Willigen"

items.title: Russian drone attacks enterprise in Kremenchuk
items.teaser: A Russian drone has struck an industrial facility in the city of Kremenchuk in Poltava Oblast.

items.title: Austrian foreign minister shares details of Kyiv embassy damage after Russian attack
items.teaser: Austria's top diplomat confirmed all mission personnel are unharmed and praised their commitment under hazardous conditions during Moscow's aerial assault on the Ukrainian capital

items.title: Zelensky outlines key topics for Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the key topics at today’s Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin include covering Ukraine’s budget needs, strengthening air defense, and a winter package of ballistic missile interceptors.

items.title: Trump says Putin upset with Zelenskyy over Kerch Bridge attack
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has told a journalist after the summit in China that Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin was upset with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy over the attack on the Kerch Bridge.

items.title: Russian forces trying to advance toward Orikhiv in small infantry groups but fail – military
items.teaser: Russian forces continue trying to advance toward Orikhiv in the Zaporizhzhia region, using small infantry groups to infiltrate Ukrainian positions. However, the Defense Forces detect and destroy the enemy in time, before they can reach the city, which remains under the control of Ukrainian defenders.

items.title: Russians strike Kharkiv: five injured, shops damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Kharkiv with drones in the early evening of 19 November, with a strike recorded in the Saltivskyi district and five people reported injured.

items.title: Trümmer russischer Drohne stürzen auf dem Gelände des Außenministeriums in Kyjiw ab
items.teaser: Infolge eines russischen Drohnenangriffs auf Kyjiw sind Drohnentrümmer auf dem Gelände des Auswärtigen Amts der Ukraine abgestürzt, teilt der Außenminister, Anrdij Sybiha, auf X mit.

items.title: Russian attack damages St Volodymyr's Cathedral in Kyiv
items.teaser: Wreckage from an aerial attack broke window panes at the 19th-century landmark, a nearby diplomatic mission and more than 10 cars in central Kyiv.

items.title: Third strike on Kerch Bridge in a week: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit railway link to occupied Crimea
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces hit the railway section of the bridge built by Russia to connect its territory with occupied Crimea. The strike halted train traffic and further disrupted a key route supplying Russian forces.

items.title: “Shenzhen is not the Yalta of Putin's dreams,” FM Sybiha says
items.teaser: The meeting of the leaders of China, the United States and Russia in Shenzhen, China, failed to fulfill Putin’s hopes of returning to the era of the Yalta Conference. It is time for him to face reality and end the war against Ukraine, which he cannot win.

items.title: Exclusive: Ukrainian authorities agree on landmark bill regulating crypto market
items.teaser: International partners have steadily put pressure on Ukraine to move forward with regulating digital assets as part of its commitments to both the EU and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

items.title: Freelance Commercial Content Writer
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent, Ukraine’s main English-language publication, is looking for a Freelance Commercial Content Writer.

items.title: Zelenskyy meets leaders of Germany, UK and France in Berlin
items.teaser: Discussions ahead of the Coalition of the Willing gathering focused on protecting Ukraine's energy grid, countering Russian strikes and coordinating allied security guarantees.

items.title: The Kerch Bridge span fell without Starlink, a Ukrainian officer says. Only weeks earlier Kyiv was asking Washington for Starshield to strike deep, Rubio said
